title: Personal Credit Cards: Money Still Owed on a Card That Is Being Closed
content:
Whether money will still be owed on a Personal Credit Cards account after it closes decides where a points cash-out made at closing is paid.

## Rule

The figure used is the card's current amount owed at the moment the matter is handled. A cash-out of points leaves it unchanged, since a deposit into a checking account does nothing to the card's debt. Money will remain owed when that figure is above zero; when it is zero, or the card is in credit, nothing will remain owed.

## Input, judgement, output (hypothetical figures)

| Current amount owed | Money will remain owed |
|---|---|
| 386.20 USD | yes |
| 0.01 USD | yes |
| 0.00 USD | no |
| minus 22.40 USD, a credit | no |
